towers.name: BOLT
towers.historical_origin: Solar militia standard, designed after the first off-world logistics split.
towers.canon_mechanic: Cheap reliability and kill-reload represent industrial standardization.

towers.name: CRYO
towers.historical_origin: A lunar volatile-control projector repurposed to arrest movement.
towers.canon_mechanic: Humans weaponize environmental engineering.

towers.name: MORTAR
towers.historical_origin: Habitat-defense artillery that fires from allied sensor tracks.
towers.canon_mechanic: It depends on the broader Human observation network.

towers.name: ARC
towers.historical_origin: A captured Lattice capacitor grounded through a Human mast.
towers.canon_mechanic: Reverse engineering turns alien field behavior into lane geometry.

towers.name: FLAK
towers.historical_origin: Anti-transmedium interception gun created after conventional targeting repeatedly lost low-signature craft.
towers.canon_mechanic: It forces aerial threats into the shared battlespace.

towers.name: CANISTER
towers.historical_origin: Mining and hull-stripping aerosols adapted for armored targets.
towers.canon_mechanic: A utilitarian Human tool with serious ethical restrictions outside combat zones.

towers.name: RECLAIMER
towers.historical_origin: Compact void hardware recovered from a wreck and mounted without full theoretical understanding.
towers.canon_mechanic: Humanity gains strength by domesticating what it does not yet comprehend.

towers.name: QUARTERMASTER
towers.historical_origin: A deployable requisition office descended from Solar emergency logistics.
towers.canon_mechanic: Paperwork becomes a combat multiplier.

towers.name: RAMPART
towers.historical_origin: Prefabricated habitat shielding converted into lane barricades.
towers.canon_mechanic: Settlement technology literally becomes defense.

towers.name: ARBALEST
towers.historical_origin: A patient magnetic siege system that stores energy while it waits for a legal firing solution.
towers.canon_mechanic: Human doctrine rewards preparation over exotic automation.

towers.name: BOMBARD
towers.historical_origin: A compact lunar mass-driver battery.
towers.canon_mechanic: The largest Human gun is powerful because the coalition can feed and spot it.

towers.name: COLDFRONT
towers.historical_origin: A climate-control field built from colony weather infrastructure.
towers.canon_mechanic: Humans manufacture local conditions rather than merely endure them.

towers.name: BEACON
towers.historical_origin: An Accord coherence allocator that chooses one protected asset at a time.
towers.canon_mechanic: Federation power concentrates through authenticated priority rather than mass fire.

towers.name: PRISM
towers.historical_origin: A continuous noetic beam that becomes stronger while identity lock remains valid.
towers.canon_mechanic: Trust and focus are mechanically inseparable.

towers.name: CHRONO
towers.historical_origin: A local memory-state restoration device, not literal universal time travel.
towers.canon_mechanic: It reasserts a recently authenticated position.

towers.name: SHEPHERD
towers.historical_origin: An Echo Reversal escort that stabilizes reconstructed allies.
towers.canon_mechanic: The Federation treats echoes as protected continuations, not ammunition.

towers.name: WARD
towers.historical_origin: Anti-spoof sanctity field created after counterfeit Ashtar transmissions.
towers.canon_mechanic: Authentication is the Federation's most important armor.

towers.name: CUSTODIAN
towers.historical_origin: Consent-scoped wardens assigned to absorb a specific breach.
towers.canon_mechanic: Sacrifice is lawful only inside the scope each warden signed.

towers.name: CONCORD
towers.historical_origin: A harmonic chain that leaves targets mutually legible to the rest of the line.
towers.canon_mechanic: The Federation wins by making isolated attacks cooperative.

towers.name: SEPULCHRE
towers.historical_origin: A temporary continuity archive for destroyed emplacements.
towers.canon_mechanic: Loss is remembered long enough to keep serving, then deliberately released.

towers.name: ORISON
towers.historical_origin: A battlefield dedication protocol that names one threat as the shared obligation.
towers.canon_mechanic: Collective purpose grants strength but risks sanctifying violence.

towers.name: ANTIPHON
towers.historical_origin: A response array that turns allied detachment losses into defensive volleys.
towers.canon_mechanic: The Accord answers sacrifice rather than consuming it silently.

towers.name: MONSTRANCE
towers.historical_origin: A revelation beam exposing armor, resistances, and hidden protections.
towers.canon_mechanic: It makes one target radically knowable.

towers.name: PHAROS
towers.historical_origin: A rotating approach-light descended from evacuation beacons.
towers.canon_mechanic: Its unalterable sweep represents law applied without favoritism.

towers.name: TOXIN
towers.historical_origin: A House biochemistry that attacks current vitality rather than armor.
towers.canon_mechanic: Extraction is most efficient before a subject is exhausted.

towers.name: SIPHON
towers.historical_origin: A noetic recovery plant that converts inflicted damage into command continuity.
towers.canon_mechanic: Violence literally funds the occupier's survival.

towers.name: EXECUTIONER
towers.historical_origin: A client-control weapon for culling assets below a profitability threshold.
towers.canon_mechanic: The Compact formalizes mercy and disposal as the same calculation.

towers.name: SIREN
towers.historical_origin: An Archonic command lure that rewrites a target's immediate allegiance.
towers.canon_mechanic: Consent is replaced by a technically valid but manufactured choice state.

towers.name: ALCHEMIST
towers.historical_origin: A death-transmutation platform that permanently learns from nearby kills.
towers.canon_mechanic: Every casualty becomes proprietary research.

towers.name: RECKONING
towers.historical_origin: A damage-ledger weapon that bills a target for recent harm.
towers.canon_mechanic: The Compact turns collective violence into debt.

towers.name: ICHOR
towers.historical_origin: A living digestive spray optimized for already wounded bodies.
towers.canon_mechanic: The deeper the wound, the more efficiently Yield is collected.

towers.name: GESTALT
towers.historical_origin: A local coercive group-mind that folds nearby deaths into itself.
towers.canon_mechanic: Growth is powerful, permanent, and vulnerable to memory collapse.

towers.name: MAW
towers.historical_origin: A removal organism that consumes one strategic body outside the Echo system.
towers.canon_mechanic: The Compact can deny even an enemy's right to leave a record.

towers.name: HUNGERING VEIL
towers.historical_origin: An Archonic field that records healing and returns it as liability.
towers.canon_mechanic: Care itself becomes taxable.

towers.name: SUTURE
towers.historical_origin: A graft system that distributes wounds across linked subjects.
towers.canon_mechanic: Individuals become one balance sheet without becoming one consenting mind.

towers.name: IMPALER
towers.historical_origin: A board-wide execution spine that seeks the deepest existing wound.
towers.canon_mechanic: The Compact attacks weakness wherever the wider system creates it.

towers.name: PYRE
towers.historical_origin: A salvaged fuel tank, igniter, and absent safety governor.
towers.canon_mechanic: Pirate strength and self-destruction share one heat meter.

towers.name: TETHER
towers.historical_origin: A cargo harpoon and salvage winch turned displacement weapon.
towers.canon_mechanic: Pirates force the enemy to travel the same dangerous route twice.

towers.name: SAPPER
towers.historical_origin: Route-denial mines planted during quiet intervals.
towers.canon_mechanic: Pirates turn unused time and unclaimed ground into hidden leverage.

towers.name: SABOTEUR
towers.historical_origin: A cross-board intrusion cell descended from gate credential theft.
towers.canon_mechanic: It attacks an opponent's infrastructure rather than the neutral wave.

towers.name: GLAIVE
towers.historical_origin: A lane-following cutter derived from rotating salvage tools.
towers.canon_mechanic: The path itself becomes a weapon.

towers.name: CYCLONE
towers.historical_origin: An atmospheric cargo lifter run far beyond passenger limits.
towers.canon_mechanic: Anything can be repurposed when certification is removed.

towers.name: CAPACITOR
towers.historical_origin: A jury-rigged bank that stores charge while no target is present.
towers.canon_mechanic: Peace is treated as ammunition waiting to happen.

towers.name: PRESS GANG
towers.historical_origin: A battlefield conscription rig that raises temporary labor from corpses.
towers.canon_mechanic: The darkest Pirate technology exposes how freedom rhetoric can conceal trafficking.

towers.name: PRIVATEER
towers.historical_origin: A gun whose targeting system carries an unofficial letter of marque.
towers.canon_mechanic: Every kill is also a financial raid on a rival commander.

towers.name: BLOOD PRICE
towers.historical_origin: A weapon purchased with enclave survival rather than money.
towers.canon_mechanic: Pirates can convert the one resource that should not be fungible.

towers.name: CARRONADE
towers.historical_origin: A capital ship's gun emplaced with its deck and heat problems intact.
towers.canon_mechanic: Overload is both signature power and forced downtime.

towers.name: STOKEHOLD
towers.historical_origin: A ship boiler that accepts friendly weapon heat instead of allowing guns to jam.
towers.canon_mechanic: A reckless fleet becomes a shared thermal economy.

towers.name: RAILGUN
towers.historical_origin: A Continuance kinetic solution kept because it remains mathematically sufficient.
towers.canon_mechanic: No ritual, proc, or gamble: only a solved firing equation.

towers.name: SINGULARITY
towers.historical_origin: A Federation containment core rebuilt on a Machine chassis after lawful ownership became impossible to establish.
towers.canon_mechanic: Cross-origin technology raises the question of whether tools remember political allegiance.

towers.name: VAULT
towers.historical_origin: A resource-allocation node that turns verified throughput into local currency.
towers.canon_mechanic: Machine economy is accounting made physical.

towers.name: DRONE BAY
towers.historical_origin: A mobile coverage system descended from autonomous inspection swarms.
towers.canon_mechanic: The only fixed structure whose effective territory moves.

towers.name: FOUNDRY
towers.historical_origin: A repair ecology that forges bodies to engage threats directly.
towers.canon_mechanic: Machine manufacturing becomes a temporary army.

towers.name: ECHO
towers.historical_origin: A repeat node that models and reissues neighboring attacks.
towers.canon_mechanic: The Vigil learns through adjacency rather than inspiration.

towers.name: QUAKE
towers.historical_origin: A crustal maintenance hammer repurposed as field-wide ground control.
towers.canon_mechanic: Old infrastructure makes the whole defended side its range.

towers.name: PYLON
towers.historical_origin: A local lattice keystone that increases the value of linked Machine hardware.
towers.canon_mechanic: Machine strength is topology, not individual heroism.

towers.name: REPLICATOR
towers.historical_origin: An autonomous construction precedent that builds another approved emplacement.
towers.canon_mechanic: Its true cost is territory and the political right to reproduce.

towers.name: NULL FIELD
towers.historical_origin: A diagnostic volume that forces systems down to walking, armor, and mortality.
towers.canon_mechanic: It does not overpower abilities; it refuses to recognize them.

towers.name: QUAD MOUNT
towers.historical_origin: Four independent targeting solvers on one heavy bed.
towers.canon_mechanic: Machine doctrine handles swarm and elite through deterministic parallelism.

towers.name: REACTOR
towers.historical_origin: A high-rated lattice core that substitutes infrastructure for local network geometry.
towers.canon_mechanic: The Machine endgame is not a bigger gun but a better system.
